about: The tools the site is made with, and the people who made them. The About page's Thank you section prints each 'thanks' in this order: **bold** is the people, [square brackets] the link to 'url'. The status page names each tool that has 'kits' on that kit's cards, as '<name> by <by>', emulators first. kit/scripts/build.py fails when a kit under kit/ has none. The words are air's: change them only when air asks.

credits.name: VICE
credits.thanks: **The VICE team**, for [VICE], the emulator every Commodore 64 game here was explained in.

credits.name: vice-mcp
credits.thanks: **Barry Walker**, for [vice-mcp], which lets an agent drive VICE.

credits.name: regenerator2000
credits.thanks: **Ricardo Quesada**, for [regenerator2000], the disassembler behind most of the listings on this site.

credits.name: ZEsarUX
credits.thanks: **César Hernández Bañó**, for [ZEsarUX], the ZX Spectrum emulator.

credits.name: SkoolKit
credits.thanks: **Richard Dymond**, for [SkoolKit], which turns a Spectrum snapshot into annotated source.

credits.name: jsbeeb
credits.thanks: **Matt Godbolt**, for [jsbeeb], the BBC Micro emulator.

credits.name: Apple2TS
credits.thanks: **Chris Torrence** and the Apple2TS contributors, for [Apple2TS], the Apple II emulator.

credits.name: plus4emu
credits.thanks: **István Varga**, for [plus4emu], the Commodore 16 and Plus/4 emulator.

credits.name: jsnes
credits.by: Ben Firshman and the jsnes contributors

credits.name: MesenCE
credits.thanks: **Sour** and the MesenCE contributors, for [MesenCE], the NES's second emulator, which the kit checks a question of accuracy against.

credits.name: Bocfel

credits.by: Tom Harte and the SingleStepTests contributors

credits.name: z80test
